title: Transmission Electron Microscopy Protocol
author: Sue Lin
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zz6f79e

steps.title: Perform Double Fixation
steps.instruction: Fix and post-fix the specimen using glutaraldehyde and osmium tetroxide in phosphate buffer.

substeps.instruction: Fix the specimen with 2.5% glutaraldehyde in phosphate buffer (pH 7.0) for more than 4 hours.
Wash the specimen three times in phosphate buffer.
Post-fix the specimen with 1% OsO4 in phosphate buffer (pH 7.0) for 1 hour.
Wash the specimen three times in phosphate buffer.

steps.title: Dehydrate the Specimen
steps.instruction: Dehydrate the specimen using a graded ethanol series and acetone.

substeps.instruction: Dehydrate through a graded series of ethanol (50%, 70%, 80%, 90%, 95%, and 100%) for approximately 15 to 20 minutes at each step.
Transfer the specimen to absolute acetone for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Infiltrate with Spurr Resin
steps.instruction: Gradually infiltrate the specimen with Spurr resin mixture.

substeps.instruction: Place the specimen in a 1:1 mixture of absolute acetone and final Spurr resin mixture for 1 hour at room temperature.
Transfer to a 1:3 mixture of absolute acetone and final resin mixture for 3 hours.
Transfer to final Spurr resin mixture overnight.

steps.title: Embed and Section Specimen
steps.instruction: Embed the specimen in resin, section it, and stain for microscopy.

substeps.instruction: Place the specimen in capsules containing embedding medium and heat at 70℃ for about 9 hours.
Stain sections with uranyl acetate for 15 minutes.
Stain sections with alkaline lead citrate for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Image the Sections
steps.instruction: Photograph the stained sections using a Hitachi Model H-7650 transmission electron microscope (Tokyo, Japan).
